assumptions.reference_customer_basis: Conditional components are left out of modeled costs unless an entry below says that the reference (typical) customer of the sector pays them (user decision, October 9, 2026). An entry applies to components of its province and fuel, for the listed sectors (residential or a commercial size band), whose notes (after the 'Provenance: ...' prefix) fully match notes_regex and whose component name fully matches name_regex (Python re.fullmatch; every given pattern must match). Only components otherwise excluded as 'conditional' qualify: alternatives, optional components, expired or not-yet-effective components and value-less market components stay excluded. Included components are itemized with reason 'reference_customer:<id>'. Ontario reference customers: residential and GS < 50 kW customers are on the Regulated Price Plan (RPP) and buy from their distributor (standard supply); customers at the 50 kW and over levels buy spot-priced energy through their distributor (non-RPP standard supply); all are Class B (not Industrial Conservation Initiative participants) and none is a wholesale market participant.
